extension.description: Launch OpenCode and switch its config: Activity Bar quick-launch, profile switcher (pure DeepSeek / pure Max JOJO / hybrid) and omos/pomos mode switcher.
container.title: OpenCode
setting.configFile: Absolute path to the OpenCode main config file (empty = auto-detect common locations).
setting.profileDir: Directory containing OpenCode config templates. Leave empty to auto-detect a 'profiles' subdirectory next to the main config; seeds DeepSeek/Jojo templates on first run.
